propositions: lru_cache on _rendered() is process-local, causing each of three xdist workers to independently re-render all 178 corpus bodies (~884 pandoc spawns), wasting ~56s of CPU on identical immutable artifacts
three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical parametrizations each recompute first pass render that _rendered() already computed, duplicating work by ~11-13s per test

replacing process-local lru_cache with session-scoped digest-keyed disk artifact shared across xdist workers via tmp_path_factory.getbasetemp().parent, sharded per stratum with worker-rotated probe order and os.mkdir-based mutual exclusion, reduces per-worker fills from three to one and largest test from 40s+ to under 18s
shared artifact digest embeds corpus JSON, wiki_render source, and pandoc version to prevent stale renders and invalidate on any input change
loser workers blocked on shared artifact acquisition fall back to local render after 150s deadline (below 300s timeout guard) to prevent deadlock on crashed winner
